data.name: Stellar Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

Everything below is built and running. It opens in stages rather than all at once.

Base Building 

About a month away.

Establish your first base with materials from the Laboratory, then build it out with up to eleven modules. Some produce passively while you are elsewhere in the galaxy, others answer on demand, and between them they reach into every part of the game. A base brings new capabilities, new materials, quality of life you will not want to give up, and a line of progression that keeps opening for as long as you invest in it.

Colonization

Roughly a month after Base Building.

Settle the galaxy. Travel out to systems that differ in the economies they support and claim them, then govern what you hold: materials to balance, work queues to keep in motion, resources to direct where they are needed. What your colonies produce returns to you as bonuses.

Dungeons

Early 2027

Instanced runs, undertaken alone or with your squadron on a weekly cycle. Enter, meet the objectives, and carry the rewards back into the progression of your account.

These are estimates, not release dates. Base Building is close, Colonization follows it, and Dungeons is the long one. If something moves, we will say so here rather than quietly let a date pass.


About the Game

An Idle Space MMORPG where you progress at your own pace, but the universe is built together.

Explore a procedural galaxy of nearly 50 million star systems alone — or join a Squadron to pool resources, raise space stations, upgrade shared buildings, and expand across the stars as one.

A Galaxy That Grows With Its Players


The galaxy holds nearly 50 million star systems, and most of them have never been visited. Every system discovered by a player joins the persistent universe — adding to a shared map that keeps expanding as long as someone keeps exploring. There's always a frontier, no matter when you arrive.

Idle, but Deep


Battle and gather run automatically with full offline progress — set your activity, log out, and come back richer. Send your Voyager on automated expeditions while you sleep. Crafting and manual exploration reward active play with deeper control and faster progress. Choose your pace.

  • Battle — automated combat against a variety of enemies with unique weaknesses, solo dungeons, weekly Squadron Dungeons, and a dedicated PvP Battlefield with its own gear and skills
  • Gather — claim resource nodes across planet bodies, asteroids, nebulae, and comets — fully idle
  • Explore — chart unknown systems manually for full control, or queue a Voyager expedition to explore while you're away
  • Craft — turn raw materials into gear through blueprints, mods, and lab queues, then deepen your build with the Catalyst system

Squadrons: The Heart of the MMO


A Squadron isn't just a chat channel — it's a shared empire.

  • Pool member taxes to fund collective infrastructure
  • Raise space stations across the galaxy and claim entire star systems
  • Upgrade Squadron buildings that grant bonuses to every member
  • Share gear through the Armory and equip your team for harder content
  • Tackle weekly Squadron Dungeons together
  • Compete in the PvP Battlefield with dedicated PvP gear and skills

Endless Progression


  • Technology tree — specialize across exploration, combat, gathering, and crafting with Quantum Cores
  • Catalyst gear customization — install Catalysts on your equipment to add stat bonuses across multiple categories, mixing and matching for the build you want
  • Base building — develop your personal base with passive and active modules, each tied to your body type and granting unique bonuses
  • Pets — recruit companions across booster, quality-of-life, and generator slots, leveling them as they fight, gather, and explore by your side
  • Solo Dungeons — instanced challenges that spawn on system discovery for solo runs and rewards
  • Player-driven economy — full marketplace with price history, rarity hunting, and tradeable premium currency
  • Voyager system — automated expeditions that explore the galaxy while you're away

Free to Play


Every system, dungeon, and skill is accessible to free players — no paywalled content, no locked features.

An optional monthly subscription adds quality-of-life features and progression bonuses for players who want them. A premium currency is available for cosmetics and convenience, and is freely tradeable on the player marketplace — committed free players can earn it through gameplay and fund their own subscription without spending.

New Realm, Fresh Start


The Steam realm launches with an empty map. No veteran advantage. No discovered systems. No claimed territory. Every Squadron is a founding dynasty. Every star is uncharted.

The galaxy waits for no one — but it belongs to everyone.

Join the Community


Connect with other captains, share strategies, follow updates, and help shape the future of the game.

Languages


English · Español · 中文

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Equiv
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equi.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU 1GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
